intro: Saturday June 27 morning tactical ideas for the June 29 (Monday) US and Korean session. The week ahead is defined by THREE binary events in rapid succession: (1) NVDA Stop Day 2 — June 29 US close above/below $195 determines full exit vs. framework reset; (2) NFP July 2 — consensus +172K into a 3-day July 4 holiday gap; (3) SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR July 10 — the largest ADR in history, with underwriter stabilization desks now actively supporting the stock. The SK Hynix ADR confirmation is the dominant positive development, transforming the KOSPI circuit-breaker recovery narrative into an institutionally backed structural recovery. All ideas below are positioned for June 29 resolution of these binaries. Regime gates still breached (SPX 106 pts below 7,460 floor, VIX 18.41, DXY 101.27). Do NOT add to NVDA or US broad tech before June 29 stop resolution AND regime gates clear.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.idea: Stop Day 2 binary — June 29 close is the fulcrum. Watch only: do NOT add NVDA before June 29 resolves. If June 29 closes above $195 → stop resets to inactive; upgrade to medium conviction HOLD; next add requires both SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 at a daily close. If June 29 closes below $195 → FULL EXIT (two-close stop triggered); no re-entry until SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 AND NVDA > $205 simultaneously.
ideas.why: NVDA closed $192.53 on June 26 (−2.20%) despite the record $334B Nasdaq closing cross — the largest passive buying event in exchange history produced a lower close. This is the most bearish possible reconstitution outcome. Stop Day 1 is active. SK Hynix ADR confirmation (July 10) validates HBM4 demand, preserving the long-term thesis, but does not clear the near-term stop framework. The only near-term positive catalyst is a SK Hynix ADR-driven Asia risk-on Monday that gaps NVDA above $195 pre-market.
ideas.trigger: June 29 close above $195 (stop reset) → upgrade to medium conviction HOLD. June 29 close below $195 → FULL EXIT. Do NOT add intraday regardless of price action — only the daily close matters for the two-close stop framework.
ideas.risk: June 29 gaps down on NVDA-specific news (hyperscaler capex cut, Morningstar supply glut thesis spreading to additional analysts); SPX opens below 7,300 (escalates to BEARISH); NFP pre-positioning by institutions selling ahead of July 2.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc.
ideas.idea: Buy June 29 KST open on ADR catalyst. The official Nasdaq ADR listing confirmation (July 10, $29.4B, underwriters BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) is the structural positive event that has been anticipated since the week of June 22. Buy if June 29 KST opens above ₩2,700,000 with KOSPI stabilizing above 8,500.
ideas.why: The $29.4B ADR underwriting is the strongest possible institutional validation of SK Hynix's HBM4 market position — Goldman Sachs, BofA, Citigroup, and JPMorgan collectively verified HBM demand before committing to this scale. Underwriter desks are now financially incentivized to stabilize the stock for the next 13 days before the July 10 listing. Record retail net buy ₩11.55T on June 26 (circuit-breaker session) is the contrarian capitulation signal. The June 26 close (₩2,673,000) was forced institutional selling (PCE risk-off, MSCI contagion) — NOT fundamental deterioration of the HBM4 demand thesis.
ideas.trigger: June 29 KST opens above ₩2,700,000 AND KOSPI opens above 8,500 → buy 50% position. Add second 50% tranche after June 30 KST close confirms stabilization above 8,500 (two-session KOSPI hold). Stop ₩2,540,000 on two consecutive KST daily closes below (unchanged).
ideas.risk: June 29 KST opens below ₩2,600,000 on US premarket risk-off (NVDA stop Day 2 trigger, KOSPI contagion from NFP pre-positioning); Samsung announces HBM4E qualification before ADR pricing supplement; ADR pricing announced below current market price (dilution discount triggers additional selling).

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: Buy the Monday dip if MU opens below $1,200. The June 26 (−2.1%) session on Morningstar supply-glut concern creates a buying opportunity: the Morningstar thesis (AI memory peak 2028, halving by 2029–2030) does not refute the $50B Q4 FY2026 guide. SK Hynix ADR ($29.4B) validates the HBM supercycle — the same HBM demand that drives MU's Q4 guide.
ideas.why: Micron's $50B Q4 FY2026 revenue guide is the most powerful earnings beat of the 2026 AI cycle. HBM3E and HBM4 capacity is sold out through 2026. AAPL/MSFT consumer hardware price increases citing memory costs confirm OEM pass-through at retail tier. Russell Growth reclassification (June 26 reconstitution) creates permanent passive demand from Growth ETFs. One Morningstar analyst note is not a consensus shift. SK Hynix ADR underwriting confirms the memory supercycle institutional conviction.
ideas.trigger: MU opens below $1,200 on Monday June 29 → buy. If MU opens above $1,250 with no pullback, wait for $1,200 entry zone. Stop $1,050 on two consecutive closes below. Size: 25-40% position — wait for SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 before full position.
ideas.risk: Morningstar thesis spreads to additional sell-side analysts (consensus shift from secular to cyclical growth narrative); Samsung announces HBM4E qualification removing sole-source premium; hot NFP July 2 drives tech multiple compression ahead of MU Q4 earnings (~September 2026).

ideas.name: Bitcoin / US Dollar
ideas.idea: Remain FLAT/CASH. Monitor June 29 UTC close for Day 1 of re-entry clock. From current $60,429 (11:03 UTC June 27), reaching $62,000 by June 29 20:00 UTC requires SK Hynix ADR-driven Asia risk-on + US Monday equity rally to translate into crypto risk appetite. Realistic scenario: Day 6 exit gate on June 29 with BTC at $60,000–$62,000.
ideas.why: Day 5 exit gate active. IBIT outflows $692M June 25 (largest since May 27) confirm institutional exit. The mild Saturday recovery ($60,429, +0.54% from $60,103 close) is low-volume weekend noise. The Fear & Greed Index at 24 (Extreme Fear) is a contrarian signal but does not override the framework. BTC has had five consecutive UTC session highs declining — the distribution ceiling is falling. Without two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 AND resumed IBIT inflows, re-entry is not justified.
ideas.trigger: June 29 20:00 UTC close above $62,000 → Day 1 of re-entry clock; watch June 30 20:00 UTC close: if also above $62,000 → re-enter at 50% position size. Do NOT re-enter on intraday price above $62,000. If June 29 close below $60,000 → next support $58,100 (June 25 session low) and structural target $57,500.
ideas.risk: SK Hynix ADR + NVDA stop reset creates stronger-than-expected Monday risk-on rally that drives BTC above $62,000 before re-entry clock activates — missed first leg of recovery; Bitcoin hash rate or network development news triggers institutional re-allocation.

ideas.name: Procure Space ETF
ideas.idea: STEP ASIDE HIGH conviction — zero position. Bond distribution formal clearance est. July 7–10. Nasdaq 100 inclusion expected July 7 (~$4.3B passive inflows) coincides with clearance window. Monitor June 29 volume for clearance pace (below 80M shares = on-track; above 150M = extended distribution). Do NOT buy ahead of the passive inclusion — the June 26 Russell 1000 inclusion was absorbed within the session; Nasdaq 100 will face the same dynamic.
ideas.why: The SpaceX $25B bond (formally settled June 26) creates dealer distribution supply for 10–12 business days that overwhelms all passive buying events. The $89B in bond demand represents $64B of demand in excess of the $25B supply — even 0.5% of these $64B in excess demand bidders immediately selling positions creates sustained $320M daily supply over multiple weeks. Volume of 126.91M shares on Day 4 (June 26) is declining but still far above the 5M shares clearance signal. Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 is a catalyst for the POST-clearance window, not a reason to re-enter now.
ideas.trigger: Volume below 5M shares/day for 2-3 consecutive sessions (est. July 7–10) → clearance confirmed; then watch for two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. If June 29 close below $150 → IG floor failure Day 1 → framework reassessment required.
ideas.risk: Bond distribution clears early (volume drops to 5M shares before July 7); Nasdaq 100 inclusion pre-positioning by QQQ managers drives SPCX above $185 before distribution clears — zero position misses the move; SpaceX announces major news (Starship milestone, Starlink profitability, IPO timeline) that overrides distribution mechanics.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms Inc.
ideas.idea: Low-conviction watch: META is the best-risk-adjusted addition in big-tech once regime gates clear. If June 29 closes see SPX above 7,420 (approaching 7,460 floor) AND VIX below 18 (approaching 17 gate), META becomes the first big-tech name to add before the full regime clearance. Do not add while VIX > 17 and SPX < 7,460.
ideas.why: META is the reported anchor customer for Qualcomm Dragonfly AI chip — a structural hedge against NVIDIA dependence not yet priced by the market. Reality Labs losses decelerating while Threads/Instagram AI engagement accelerating. PEG discount vs. MSFT and GOOGL at current multiples. Meta AI (Llama 4) gaining enterprise developer adoption. The KOSPI/VIX regime environment is the sole near-term obstacle.
ideas.trigger: Both SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 close simultaneously (regime cleared) → add META on the following session open. Stop: 7% below entry. Target: 10% above entry on 4-week horizon.
ideas.risk: Regime gates remain breached through July NFP → META drifts lower with broader tech; FTC/EU regulatory action on Meta AI data practices; Qualcomm Dragonfly partnership reported inaccurately or delayed.

ideas.name: Alphabet Inc.
ideas.idea: Lowest-conviction big-tech watch. GOOGL weakness from AI talent exodus (Shazeer, Jumper departures to Mistral/Meta/Anthropic) and QCOM+META data center headwind has created the widest valuation discount vs. peers since 2022. Watch for Q2 earnings (mid-July) as the first potential catalyst to re-rate. Do not add before regime clearance.
ideas.why: Google Search revenue grew 12% YoY in Q1 2026 despite AI Overview rollout — the feared 'AI kills Search advertising' narrative has not materialized in revenue. Gemini Ultra 2.0 is competitive with GPT-4o. GCP AI workloads growing faster than Azure percentage-wise on a smaller base. YouTube Shorts monetization accelerating. Waymo expanding beyond SF/LA (Austin, DC). At current valuations, GOOGL has the widest AI monetization margin of safety in big-tech.
ideas.trigger: Regime gates clear (SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17) AND Q2 earnings beat consensus → add. If Q2 Search revenue growth decelerates below 10% → do not add regardless of regime clearance. Stop: 8% below entry.
ideas.risk: AI-native search (Perplexity, Claude.ai, ChatGPT) accelerates Search displacement faster than GOOGL can monetize AI answers; EU DMA compliance costs materialize; talent exodus from DeepMind and Google Research accelerates.
